artworks.title: Waterlilies
artworks.dimensions:
image: 127 x 176 mm
sheet:  261 x 315 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows two large lotus flowers surrounded by lily pads. The color palette consists of shades of brown and light beige, giving the artwork a sepia-toned appearance. The central lotus is positioned slightly to the right, while the second one is to the left, forming a diagonal across the composition with the lily pads filling the background.

artworks.title: White Mountains
artworks.dimensions:
image: 151 x 298 mm
sheet:  315 x 480 mm
plate:  185 x 324 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape. The perspective is slightly elevated. The horizon is high in the scene, with mountains in the distance. The mountains have soft contours. Closest to us, there is a field with vegetation and two walking figures. Beyond them, cattle graze in a field. A small structure, possibly a farmhouse, is seen nestled in the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of brown and hints of sepia, accentuating the detailed line work.

artworks.title: Manhattan Evening
artworks.dimensions:
image: 308 x 238 mm
sheet:  370 x 280 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a densely clustered cityscape viewed from across the water. The horizon is where the city buildings meet the water, reflecting the skyline. Tall buildings of varying heights create an undulating silhouette against the sky. The artwork shows fine, stippled brushstrokes, adding texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray, emphasizing the buildings' outlines and shadows. A boat moves along the water, providing scale to the structures. Smoke or steam rises from some rooftops.

artworks.title: Stag in the Moonlight
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a stag standing on a snow-covered path in a forest. The stag is on the right side of the image, facing the distant horizon. The horizon is low in the composition, where the snowy ground meets the silhouettes of bare trees extending skyward. The artwork uses a monochrome palette of varying shades of grey and black. The textures are soft, with details in the trees and stag's fur created by hatching and stippling. In the distance, an almost full moon shines through the bare branches, casting a gentle glow over the landscape.

artworks.title: At Sea
artworks.dimensions:
image: 204 x 134 mm
primary sheet: 271 x 186 mm
secondary sheet: 307 x 245 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays an ocean view with rolling waves under a cloudy sky. A ship with billowing sails and trailing smoke is visible on the right side of the horizon. The brushstrokes depict detailed lines resembling etching to portray the waves and sky's movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic in charcoal and sepia tones, creating a timeless and solemn atmosphere. The contrast between the dark ocean and sky with the lighter shapes highlights the ship's solitary presence.

artworks.title: Summer by the Lakeside
artworks.dimensions:
image: 176 x 113 mm
primary sheet: 269 x 195 mm
secondary sheet: 308 x 243 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a densely wooded area with a view of a serene body of water reflecting the moon. The horizon is obscured by trees, emphasizing the immediate landscape. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures of bark and branches precisely. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to create a tranquil composition. Twisted trees dominate the foreground with a sense of depth, while the moon casts light on the water in the distance.

artworks.title: The "L"
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 307 x 251 mm
Sheet: 403 x 287 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays elevated train tracks forming curved lines and angles, creating an abstract depiction of urban infrastructure. The lines converge and diverge throughout the composition, leading the viewer's eye. A train travels along the tracks, passing geometric buildings in the background. Light and shadow play off the structures, adding depth to the cityscape.

artworks.title: Untitled (Garden Scene)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 312 x 218 mm
sheet:  412 x 297 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene under a muted sky with no distinct horizon visible. There are bare trees and buildings in the distance, including what seems to be a tower. The etching style features thin, detailed lines capturing the intricacy of the scene, particularly in the trees and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, gray, and white. In the foreground, there is a wheelbarrow and several baskets scattered across a snow-covered field. Beyond that, a group of individuals can be seen working, bending over baskets. The background shows silhouettes of buildings and trees, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Untitled (Wooden House in City)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 207 x 302 mm
sheet:  326 x 449 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene with a path, wooden fencing, closely packed buildings, some on stilts over water, and larger buildings in the distance. The artwork features detailed cross-hatching, a monochromatic color palette of sepia and black, and a historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Untitled (Wooden House in City)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 207 x 302 mm
sheet:  276 x 393 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an urban landscape with intricate etching techniques. The view is slightly elevated, displaying dilapidated wooden buildings and fences dominating the lower portion. The structures appear haphazardly constructed with uneven lines suggesting wear. In the distance, taller brick buildings rise with chimneys punctuating the skyline. The horizon line is high, indicated by rooflines and distant building silhouettes. The etching features fine line work, showcasing textures of wood, brick, and fence. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of browns and taupes. A winding path on the ground leads towards the structures.

artworks.title: Japanese Fantasy
artworks.dimensions:
image: 287 x 202 mm
sheet:  467 x 382 mm
plate:   295 x 210 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has delicate facial features and neatly styled hair with hairpins. She is wearing a patterned kimono and holding a fan. Next to her is a vase with blooming flowers. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Summer—Easthampton
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural landscape with various elements like trees, grass, a windmill, buildings, and a pond. The horizon line is near the top, and the scene has a monochromatic color palette of black, white, and sepia tones. The intricate brushstrokes capture fine details, including trees and foliage, with gnarled trees framing the composition. In the background, a distant hamlet is visible among the trees, along with a reflective pond. The sky above shows wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Santa Fe
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a dusty street scene with a group of donkeys. The perspective allows viewing along the street from a slightly elevated angle. Donkeys are shown close to us, with some standing and others resting on the ground. The scene includes rustic buildings made of timber along the left side of the dirt road, with roofs supported by wooden beams. These buildings extend into the distance, framing the scene and converging at the vanishing point. There is no distinct horizon visible, with the road and buildings continuing indefinitely. The artist utilizes fine, detailed etching technique to create texture and depth, using lines and cross-hatching for light and shadow effects. The color palette is monochromatic, mostly grey, contributing to the historical and reflective mood of the image.

artworks.title: Harvest at San Juan, New Mexico
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a group of horses being driven around a large haystack enclosed by tall sticks. In the background are faint outlines of buildings or trees. The etching technique used creates detailed textures and movement. The color palette is limited to sepia tones. Two figures are herding the horses in the foreground, with more figures and open land in the distance. The sky above is filled with dramatic clouds.

artworks.title: Bridge and Trees
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a serene landscape with tall trees and a calm body of water reflecting the foliage. The scene is portrayed in monochromatic tones, with detailed textures and intricate line work. The horizon is obscured by dense vegetation, with the sky softly rendered in the background.

artworks.title: Morning
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path, hills, water, a wooden fence, foliage, a boat, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Empty Cradle
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated against a dark, rocky background. The person is in a relaxed pose with arms crossed over their lap and leaning slightly to the right. They have medium-length dark, straight hair and natural features. Their expression is calm as they look towards the viewer. The person is wearing a light-colored, fringed robe. Nearby, there is a woven basket or mat and a slender stick or pole. The background includes rugged rocks and sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Making Propeller Blades
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial workshop filled with machinery and mechanical equipment. Large gears and funnels are arranged around the room. In the background, a large arched window reveals smoke stacks from an industrial landscape. The room is depicted with detailed shading and cross-hatching, showcasing the machinery with depth and texture. Light and shadow are emphasized to capture the industrial atmosphere.

artworks.title: Cape Ann Willows
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from a slightly elevated perspective, with a tranquil scene. The horizon is high in the composition, showing a vast view. There are a few distant trees and silhouettes blending into the sky. The brushstrokes are expressive and fluid, with a sketch-like quality depicting texture and movement in the trees and ground. The color palette is primarily monochrome, using shades of black and grey. Near the viewer, there are low plants and shrubs on sandy ground, leading to a small body of water reflecting dense trees. In the distance, the landscape becomes more open and sparse towards the horizon.

artworks.title: A Glass with the Squire
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing in a domestic setting. The man on the left wears a long coat and a top hat, holding a glass in his right hand. The man on the right also wears a top hat and a suit, looking at the other man. They stand near a cabinet with bottles and decorations, and a mirror with foliage hangs on the wall behind them. Another cabinet with glass doors, a framed picture, and a small American flag on a shelf are also visible in the background. The setting has wooden floors and walls.

artworks.title: Single Hollyhocks
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The artwork displays two large flowers as the central focus, with their petals intricately detailed and surrounded by smaller flower buds. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of black, white, and gray. The flowers are positioned centrally, with their petals extending outward to the left and center of the image, while the flower stem and buds curve slightly to the right. The artist's signature and date are visible at the bottom left of the image.

artworks.title: Sweet Peas
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a cluster of sweet pea flowers with delicate, flowing petals, rendered in fine lines. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of light to dark gray. The flowers are positioned centrally, with their stems and tendrils extending upwards. Various petals appear to be opening in different directions across most of the image. In the upper right corner, the number "6" is inscribed, and towards the bottom right, there is a signature and date.

artworks.title: Profile Head of a Woman
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 200 x 154 mm
Sheet:  269 x 204 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a woman's upper half in profile, facing to the right. The woman is seated with her head slightly turned, revealing her detailed facial features. Her hair is styled with a soft wave and appears pulled back. She wears a simple garment with minimal detailing. The background is plain, with subtle texture. No accessories are visible.

artworks.title: Woodsman
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a person standing in a snowy forest, shown from behind as they appear to be chopping wood. The individual is positioned with their feet apart, legs slightly bent, and left arm down; the right arm is raised holding an axe above their shoulder. The person has short, curly hair, and their head is turned slightly to the right. The clothing consists of a long-sleeved shirt, rolled-up sleeves, pants, and boots. The person is holding an axe with no visible jewelry. The background shows snow-covered evergreen trees, creating a forest setting. The artistic style of the image resembles a woodcut illustration, with textured details.
